verses.original: אָ֭דָם יְל֣וּד אִשָּׁ֑ה קְצַ֥ר יָ֝מִ֗ים וּֽשְׂבַֽע־ רֹֽגֶז׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām yə·lūḏ ’iš·šāh qə·ṣar yā·mîm ū·śə·ḇa‘- rō·ḡez
verses.literal: Man who is born of woman is short of days and full of trouble
verses.literalPt: O homem, nascido da mulher, é de poucos dias e cheio de inquietação.

verses.original: כְּצִ֣יץ יָ֭צָא וַיִּמָּ֑ל וַיִּבְרַ֥ח כַּ֝צֵּ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ṣîṣ yā·ṣā way·yim·māl way·yiḇ·raḥ kaṣ·ṣêl wə·lō ya·‘ă·mō·wḏ
verses.literal: Like a flower he comes forth then withers away like a fleeting shadow . . . he does not endure
verses.literalPt: Como flor, nasce e murcha; como sombra foge e não permanece.

verses.original: אַף־ עַל־ זֶ֭ה פָּקַ֣חְתָּ עֵינֶ֑ךָ וְאֹ֘תִ֤י תָבִ֖יא בְמִשְׁפָּ֣ט עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- ‘al- zeh pā·qaḥ·tā ‘ê·ne·ḵā wə·’ō·ṯî ṯā·ḇî ḇə·miš·pāṭ ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: Do You open Your eyes to one like this Will You bring him into judgment before You
verses.literalPt: Sobre um tal abres os teus olhos? A mim me fazes entrar em juízo contigo?

verses.original: מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן טָ֭הוֹר מִטָּמֵ֗א לֹ֣א אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yit·tên ṭā·hō·wr miṭ·ṭā·mê lō ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: Who can bring out clean from unclean No one
verses.literalPt: Oxalá que o puro pudesse sair do imundo? Não é possível!

verses.original: אִ֥ם חֲרוּצִ֨ים׀ יָמָ֗יו מִֽסְפַּר־ חֳדָשָׁ֥יו אִתָּ֑ךְ חֻקּוֹ עָ֝שִׂ֗יתָ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ’im ḥă·rū·ṣîm yā·māw mis·par- ḥo·ḏā·šāw ’it·tāḵ ḥuq·qō ‘ā·śî·ṯā wə·lō ya·‘ă·ḇō·wr
verses.literal: Since his days are determined and the number of his months is with You and since You have set limits that he cannot exceed
verses.literalPt: Visto que os seus dias estão contados, o número dos seus meses, nas tuas mãos, e lhe tens demarcado limites intransponíveis.

verses.original: שְׁעֵ֣ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וְיֶחְדָּ֑ל עַד־ יִ֝רְצֶ֗ה כְּשָׂכִ֥יר יוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·‘êh mê·‘ā·lāw wə·yeḥ·dāl ‘aḏ- yir·ṣeh kə·śā·ḵîr yō·w·mōw
verses.literal: look away from him and let him rest so he can enjoy his day as a hired hand
verses.literalPt: Aparta dele o teu rosto, para que descanse, até que, qual jornaleiro, goze do seu dia.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יֵ֥שׁ לָעֵ֗ץ תִּ֫קְוָ֥ה אִֽם־ יִ֭כָּרֵת וְע֣וֹד יַחֲלִ֑יף וְ֝יֹֽנַקְתּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תֶחְדָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî yêš lā·‘êṣ tiq·wāh ’im- yik·kā·rêṯ wə·‘ō·wḏ ya·ḥă·lîp̄ wə·yō·naq·tōw lō ṯeḥ·dāl
verses.literal: For there is hope for a tree If it is cut down it will sprout again and its tender shoots will not fail
verses.literalPt: A esperança para a árvore, sendo cortada, é que torne a brotar, e que não cessem os seus renovos.

verses.original: אִם־ יַזְקִ֣ין בָּאָ֣רֶץ שָׁרְשׁ֑וֹ וּ֝בֶעָפָ֗ר יָמ֥וּת גִּזְעֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yaz·qîn bā·’ā·reṣ šā·rə·šōw ū·ḇe·‘ā·p̄ār yā·mūṯ giz·‘ōw
verses.literal: If its roots grow old in the ground and its stump dies in the soil
verses.literalPt: Ainda que a sua raiz envelheça na terra, e o seu tronco morra no pó,

verses.original: מֵרֵ֣יחַ מַ֣יִם יַפְרִ֑חַ וְעָשָׂ֖ה קָצִ֣יר כְּמוֹ־ נָֽטַע׃
verses.transliteration: mê·rê·aḥ ma·yim yap̄·ri·aḥ wə·‘ā·śāh qā·ṣîr kə·mōw- nā·ṭa‘
verses.literal: at the scent of water it will bud and put forth twigs like a sapling
verses.literalPt: contudo, ao cheiro de água, brotará e lançará ramos como uma planta.

verses.original: וְגֶ֣בֶר יָ֭מוּת וַֽיֶּחֱלָ֑שׁ וַיִּגְוַ֖ע אָדָ֣ם וְאַיּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡe·ḇer yā·mūṯ way·ye·ḥĕ·lāš way·yiḡ·wa‘ ’ā·ḏām wə·’ay·yōw
verses.literal: But a man dies and is laid low he breathes his last and where is he
verses.literalPt: O homem, porém, morre e fica prostrado; expira o homem e onde está?

verses.original: אָֽזְלוּ־ מַ֭יִם מִנִּי־ יָ֑ם וְ֝נָהָ֗ר יֶחֱרַ֥ב וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·zə·lū- ma·yim min·nî- yām wə·nā·hār ye·ḥĕ·raḇ wə·yā·ḇêš
verses.literal: As water disappears from the sea and a river becomes parched and dry
verses.literalPt: Como as águas se retiram do mar, e o rio se esgota e seca,

verses.original: וְאִ֥ישׁ שָׁכַ֗ב וְֽלֹא־ יָ֫ק֥וּם עַד־ בִּלְתִּ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ וְלֹֽא־ יֵ֝עֹ֗רוּ מִשְּׁנָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš šā·ḵaḇ wə·lō- yā·qūm ‘aḏ- bil·tî šā·ma·yim lō yā·qî·ṣū wə·lō- yê·‘ō·rū miš·šə·nā·ṯām
verses.literal: so a man lies down and does not rise Until the heavens are no more he will not be awakened or roused from sleep
verses.literalPt: assim o homem se deita e não se levanta. Enquanto existirem os céus, não acordará, nem será despertado do seu sono.

verses.original: מִ֤י יִתֵּ֨ן׀ בִּשְׁא֬וֹל תַּצְפִּנֵ֗נִי תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי עַד־ שׁ֣וּב אַפֶּ֑ךָ תָּ֤שִׁ֥ית לִ֖י חֹ֣ק וְתִזְכְּרֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: mî yit·tên biš·’ō·wl taṣ·pi·nê·nî tas·tî·rê·nî ‘aḏ- šūḇ ’ap·pe·ḵā tā·šîṯ lî ḥōq wə·ṯiz·kə·rê·nî
verses.literal: If only . . . You would hide me in Sheol and conceal me until Your anger has passed If only You would appoint a time for me and then remember me
verses.literalPt: Quem me dera que me escondesses no Sheol, que me ocultasses até que a tua ira tenha passado, que, após um tempo determinado, te lembrasses de mim!

verses.original: אִם־ יָמ֥וּת גֶּ֗בֶר הֲיִ֫חְיֶ֥ה כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י צְבָאִ֣י אֲיַחֵ֑ל עַד־ בּ֝֗וֹא חֲלִיפָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yā·mūṯ ge·ḇer hă·yiḥ·yeh kāl- yə·mê ṣə·ḇā·’î ’ă·ya·ḥêl ‘aḏ- bō·w ḥă·lî·p̄ā·ṯî
verses.literal: When a man dies will he live again All the days of my hard service I will wait until my renewal comes
verses.literalPt: Se o homem morrer, acaso, tornará a viver? Todos os dias da minha milícia esperaria eu, até que viesse a minha dispensa.

verses.original: תִּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ךָּ לְֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ תִכְסֹֽף׃
verses.transliteration: tiq·rā wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’e·‘ĕ·ne·kā lə·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā ṯiḵ·sōp̄
verses.literal: You will call and I will answer You will desire the work of Your hands
verses.literalPt: Tu chamarias, e eu te responderia; serias afeiçoado à obra das tuas mãos.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עַ֭תָּה צְעָדַ֣י תִּסְפּ֑וֹר לֹֽא־ תִ֝שְׁמ֗וֹר עַל־ חַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘at·tāh ṣə·‘ā·ḏay tis·pō·wr lō- ṯiš·mō·wr ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî
verses.literal: For then You would count my steps but would not keep track of my sin
verses.literalPt: Agora, porém, contas os meus passos; porventura, não observas o meu pecado?

verses.original: חָתֻ֣ם בִּצְר֣וֹר פִּשְׁעִ֑י וַ֝תִּטְפֹּ֗ל עַל־ עֲוֺנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ṯum biṣ·rō·wr piš·‘î wat·tiṭ·pōl ‘al- ‘ă·wō·nî
verses.literal: My transgression would be sealed in a bag and You would cover over my iniquity
verses.literalPt: A minha transgressão está selada num saco; e guardas fechada a minha iniquidade.

verses.original: וְ֭אוּלָם הַר־ נוֹפֵ֣ל יִבּ֑וֹל וְ֝צ֗וּר יֶעְתַּ֥ק מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām har- nō·w·p̄êl yib·bō·wl wə·ṣūr ye‘·taq mim·mə·qō·mōw
verses.literal: But as a mountain erodes and crumbles and a rock is dislodged from its place
verses.literalPt: Mas o monte que se esboroa, desfaz-se, e a penha se remove do seu lugar;

verses.original: אֲבָנִ֤ים׀ שָׁ֥חֲקוּ מַ֗יִם תִּשְׁטֹֽף־ סְפִיחֶ֥יהָ עֲפַר־ אָ֑רֶץ וְתִקְוַ֖ת אֱנ֣וֹשׁ הֶאֱבַֽדְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇā·nîm šā·ḥă·qū ma·yim tiš·ṭōp̄- sə·p̄î·ḥe·hā ‘ă·p̄ar- ’ā·reṣ wə·ṯiq·waṯ ’ĕ·nō·wōš he·’ĕ·ḇaḏ·tā
verses.literal: as water wears away the stones and torrents wash away the soil . . . so You destroy a man’s hope
verses.literalPt: As águas gastam as pedras, as suas inundações arrebatam o pó da terra. Assim fazes perecer a esperança do homem.

verses.original: תִּתְקְפֵ֣הוּ לָ֭נֶצַח וַֽיַּהֲלֹ֑ךְ מְשַׁנֶּ֥ה פָ֝נָ֗יו וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: tiṯ·qə·p̄ê·hū lā·ne·ṣaḥ way·ya·hă·lōḵ mə·šan·neh p̄ā·nāw wat·tə·šal·lə·ḥê·hū
verses.literal: You forever overpower him and he passes on You change his countenance and send him away
verses.literalPt: Prevaleces para sempre contra ele, e ele passa; mudas o seu rosto e o despedes.

verses.original: יִכְבְּד֣וּ בָ֭נָיו וְלֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וְ֝יִצְעֲר֗וּ וְֽלֹא־ יָבִ֥ין לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yiḵ·bə·ḏū ḇā·nāw wə·lō yê·ḏā‘ wə·yiṣ·‘ă·rū wə·lō- yā·ḇîn lā·mōw
verses.literal: If his sons receive honor he does not know it if they are brought low he is unaware . . .
verses.literalPt: Seus filhos recebem honras, e ele não o sabe; são humilhados, mas ele nada percebe a respeito deles.

verses.original: אַךְ־ בְּ֭שָׂרוֹ עָלָ֣יו יִכְאָ֑ב וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ עָלָ֥יו תֶּאֱבָֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- bə·śā·rōw ‘ā·lāw yiḵ·’āḇ wə·nap̄·šōw ‘ā·lāw te·’ĕ·ḇāl
verses.literal: He feels only the pain of his own body and mourns only for himself . . .
verses.literalPt: Somente para si mesmo sente dores a sua carne, e para si mesmo lamenta a sua alma.
